note: Fairgrounds campground on Ottawa Beach Road in Holland, run by the Ottawa County Fair, with open, grassy sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the fair's own page: $38/night (2026), public nightly camping Apr 17 - Oct 15 apart from a few event closures and fair week (4-H/vendors/board only), Campspot booking six months ahead, phone 616-422-5445. Changed season 04-18/10-14 -> 04-17/10-15 with the event closures in season.note; added max rig 50 ft and pull-throughs (Campspot), showers/flush toilets/paid Wi-Fi, booking window. Note trimmed (closures now in season.note). Not a fair-week-only campground, unlike Mason County.
flags: Ownership: the entry says `local`, but the campground is run by the Ottawa County Fair Association (IRS EIN 38-6089492, a 501(c)(5) agricultural organization in Holland), which leased the land from Park Township in 1959 ('lease the property from Park Township', history page); no county-government role is stated. By the fair-board rule it should be `private`.

Fair-week and event closures: no public camping during the Ottawa County Fair (July 27 - Aug 2, 2026: 'Camping only for 4H, vendors, and OCF board members') and no camping June 18-21, Aug 6-9 and Aug 30 - Sep 10, 2026; otherwise open nightly to the public Apr 17 - Oct 15, so it passes the nightly-camping test that dropped Mason County.
